numeric_calibration_episode_contract.query_order_rule: the frozen 16-row query/context schedule is consumed in exact listed order and is never permuted, shuffled or selected by any seed

exact_canonical_composition_lookup.heldout_update: add only legally observed adaptation-query outcomes to their exact key

graph_lookup.graph_schema: four public feature-node types: one context token plus one role-specific primitive token for each of three roles; each legal episode contributes its binary outcome to all four incident feature nodes
graph_lookup.prediction: for the query's four feature nodes compute each Beta(1,1)-smoothed incident-outcome mean and return their unweighted arithmetic mean
graph_lookup.heldout_update: each legally observed adaptation-query outcome increments exactly its four public feature-node success/count pairs
graph_lookup.missing_node_fallback: Beta(1,1)-smoothed global source mean for that node contribution

episodic_traversal.graph_schema: bipartite graph of legal episode nodes and the same four public feature nodes; an episode is incident to its context and three role-specific primitive tokens
episodic_traversal.traversal: from each of the query's four feature nodes traverse feature->episode_1->feature->episode_2; for every stored episode_2, weight equals the exact count of such length-3 edge paths, including repeated paths but excluding any episode without a path
episodic_traversal.prediction: (1 + sum_episode weight*binary_outcome)/(2 + sum_episode weight); if total weight is zero use Beta(1,1)-smoothed global source mean
episodic_traversal.heldout_update: append each legally observed adaptation-query episode and its four incidences before the next checkpoint
episodic_traversal.tie_break: ascending canonical source-row ordinal then ascending heldout-history ordinal during graph construction; accumulation is integer and order-invariant

nearest_neighbor_descriptor.estimate: uniform mean of the five nearest legal rows
nearest_neighbor_descriptor.heldout_update: legally observed adaptation-query rows join the neighbor pool
nearest_neighbor_descriptor.tie_break: ascending canonical composition then ascending context token then source-row ordinal

no_meta_from_scratch_residual.local_model: same four-dimensional MAP/Newton residual update as feasible reference

source_trained_current_packet_static.model: exact frozen global component of feasible reference with u_task=[0,0,0,0]

source_trained_primitive_additive_only.model: same deterministic logistic Newton fit restricted to intercept, context, role-primitive and context-by-role-primitive blocks

source_trained_pairwise_factorization_st.pair_estimate: Beta(1,1)-smoothed source mean converted to logit with probability clamped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]
source_trained_pairwise_factorization_st.prediction_logit: public-context smoothed logit plus one third of the sum over three edges of (pair_logit - public-context logit)

feedback_shuffled.model: feasible reference global model plus local MAP update
feedback_shuffled.mutation: for each prefix with at least two outcomes, cyclically rotate observed outcomes left by one while holding contexts/compositions fixed; a one-row prefix uses the frozen source prediction and records insufficient-shuffle coverage

fitted_legal_full_history_decoder.model: at each checkpoint recompute the exact feasible-reference local MAP optimum from zero using the complete legal history prefix and frozen global coefficients

legal_recency_ewma.initial_value: frozen source-model prediction for the query packet

within_task_adaptation.AULC_formula: sum over adjacent checkpoints (k_i-k_(i-1))*(loss(k_(i-1))+loss(k_i))/2 divided by 16
within_task_adaptation.aggregate_AULC: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-task normalized AULC
within_task_adaptation.control_envelope_rule: compute every fixed control-minus-reference normalized task-AULC difference separately; the reported envelope effect is their minimum, and no control is selected by calibration mean, checkpoint or bootstrap winner
within_task_adaptation.effect_definition: minimum across the 10 fixed adaptation controls of mean_task(control_AULC - live_reference_AULC)
within_task_adaptation.pass_direction: every one of the 10 per-control Bonferroni one-sided normal lower bounds must exceed fixed SESOI_adaptation_Brier_AULC; no compensation
within_task_adaptation.checkpoint_zero_identity_required: live and frozen reference predictions and serialized global state hashes identical

diagnostic_ranking.metric: top-action expected regret using evaluator-only true probabilities

canonical_metric_core.single_logic_path_rule: numeric calibration and final heldout scoring must call these exact metrics.py callables with the applicable frozen episode contract; neither consumer may implement Brier, AULC, control-envelope or task-difference arithmetic
canonical_metric_core.byte_equal_fixture_rule: the same serialized per-prediction fixture passed through numeric-freeze and final-producer adapters must yield byte-identical task-loss, AULC and per-control-difference records from the canonical callables

fixed_before_any_outcome_calibration.primary_multiplicity_method: Bonferroni over the exact 9 forward plus 10 adaptation invalidating-control comparisons; per-comparison alpha=0.05/19
fixed_before_any_outcome_calibration.power_planning_alternative: every invalidating-control difference equals 2*SESOI for its axis, leaving a one-SESOI separation from the material null margin
fixed_before_any_outcome_calibration.final_confidence_interval_method: for each fixed control separately, one-sided normal lower bound mean_task_difference - NormalDist.inv_cdf(1-0.05/19)*sqrt(unbiased_task_difference_variance/N); no winner-selected or envelope bootstrap
fixed_before_any_outcome_calibration.full_history_equivalence_method: two one-sided task-cluster tests at alpha 0.05; underpowered maps to ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN

variance_only_calibration_algorithm.allowed_data: frozen source-train tasks for global fitting plus exactly the s=2 query/probe tasks, schedules and scoring population in /numeric_calibration_episode_contract for paired task-difference variance only
variance_estimands: for each ID in /axes/forward_transfer/invalidating_control_envelope, unbiased sample variance across 128 numeric-calibration tasks of that fixed control's /numeric_calibration_episode_contract/forward_task_difference_by_control

for each ID in /axes/within_task_adaptation/invalidating_control_envelope, unbiased sample variance across 128 numeric-calibration tasks of that fixed control's /numeric_calibration_episode_contract/adaptation_task_difference_by_control
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.comparison_count: exactly 19 from the frozen ordered concatenation of the 9 forward and 10 adaptation invalidating-control envelopes
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.per_control_required_n: apply the required_n_formula separately to every fixed axis/control variance with that axis's frozen SESOI; this plans each comparison at alpha=0.05/19 and beta=0.10/19 for the 2*SESOI planning alternative; observed mean gaps never enter
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.axis_required_n: maximum per-control required_n within the exact frozen invalidating_control_envelope for that axis; no control is selected or removed by calibration mean loss
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.joint_power_rule: under the frozen normal planning approximation, per-comparison beta=0.10/19 and the union bound make the probability that all 19 material comparisons pass at least 0.90 when every true control difference equals 2*SESOI
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.final_inference_rule: heldout computes every fixed per-control task-difference mean/variance and its Bonferroni lower bound; an axis passes only if every one of its control lower bounds exceeds that axis's SESOI; the reported envelope effect is the minimum per-control mean difference and no control is selected by calibration data or bootstrap winner switching
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.selection_rule: choose the smallest value in [64,128,256,512] greater than or equal to joint_required_n
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.ceiling_rule: if joint_required_n exceeds 512, emit INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED_CLOSE_CAOT without threshold, model, generator or grid change
variance_only_calibration_algorithm.tie_rule: the smallest sufficient grid value always wins
